channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Supreme Court: California parents may be told about their transgender child at school
item.description: The Supreme Court majority said the student privacy policy enforced in California infringes on parents' rights and the free exercise of religion.

item.title: Trump is rewriting the 'you break it, you own it' rule in Iran war
item.description: It’s far from clear that the president has a coherent plan for replacing Iran’s radical Islamist autocracy with a friendlier regime.

item.title: Melania Trump presides at U.N. Security Council meeting on children in conflict
item.description: Hanging over Monday's meeting was what Iranian state media say was an airstrike that hit a girls' school, killing at least 165 people and wounding dozens.

item.title: Car insurance rates are skyrocketing in California. Here's why
item.description: Auto insurance rates have surged because of high inflation and soaring vehicle repair costs in the car capital of the country.

item.title: Michael Jackson molested boy at homes of Elton John, Elizabeth Taylor, lawsuit alleges
item.description: A lawsuit filed against Jackson’s estate accuses the late pop singer of grooming, drugging, raping and sexually assaulting four of the Cascio children.

item.title: Thousands rally in Westwood as U.S.-Iran war escalates, calling for a 'free Iran'
item.description: Demonstrators gather outside the federal building in Westwood, the epicenter of L.A.'s sprawling Iranian diaspora, to celebrate the fall of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

item.title: U.S. military bases step up security measures as war against Iran continues
item.description: Military bases across the country are stepping up security measures amid the U.S.-Israeli war against Iran.

item.title: Trump says U.S. military operations in Iran could last a month or 'far longer'
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth declined to say how long the U.S. expects to take to complete its mission in Iran. Separately, officials said the death toll among U.S. service members had climbed to six.

item.title: 'Stop the war': Los Angeles protesters decry U.S.-Israeli attacks on Iran
item.description: Speakers called the attack an illegal act of war that violated the sovereignty of Iran and its people in an effort to force regime change.

item.title: FBI scrutiny of Carvalho, LAUSD began with tip from N.Y. prosecutors examining fraud at AI firm
item.description: Parents commend the choice of Andres Chait as acting superintendent as LAUSD grapples with an ongoing inquiry into Supt. Alberto Carvalho after recent FBI raids.
